title: Morning Height Boost
script: You're taller in the morning What if gravity never pressed on you? Astronauts experience this Their spinal discs decompress in zero gravity But here's what happens on Earth Your spinal discs slowly squeeze out water and lose height You're up to a couple of centimetres taller in the morning than at night It's because the soft discs in your spine compress under your weight all day You could fit a pencil in the space your spine shrinks each day But that's not even the strange part You soak it back overnight while you sleep You're like an astronaut, but on Earth Your body is always changing You're taller in the morning

scenes.voiceover: What if gravity never pressed on you?
Their spinal discs decompress in zero gravity
But here's what happens on Earth
Your spinal discs slowly squeeze out water and lose height
You're up to a couple of centimetres taller in the morning than at night
It's because the soft discs in your spine compress under your weight all day
You could fit a pencil in the space your spine shrinks each day
But that's not even the strange part
You soak it back overnight while you sleep
You're like an astronaut, but on Earth
